content:
Overview

Ciudad Juárez is a city in Chihuahua with a population of 1,512,354. Major border city with a strong manufacturing base, crossing the Rio Grande from El Paso, Texas. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
